name: Q-HNSW
desc: HNSW approximate nearest-neighbor search graph (Malkov & Yashunin 2018)

name: Q-LSM
desc: Log-Structured Merge-tree: WAL, MemTable, SSTables, k-way merge compaction, tombstones

name: Q-COL
desc: Columnar analytics engine: bitmap filter masks, hash GROUP BY, dictionary & run-length encoding

name: Q-STREAM
desc: Windowed stream processor: tumbling/sliding/session windows, watermarks, late-event handling

name: Q-MEM
desc: Arena allocator: jemalloc-style size classes, slab carving, O(1) free lists, fragmentation stats
concept_behind: jemalloc / APR pools / game engine allocators

name: Q-GROVER
desc: Grover's quantum search algorithm: full statevector simulation, optimal amplitude amplification, QFT
concept_behind: Quantum speedup over classical search — O(√N) vs O(N)

name: Q-KYBER
desc: CRYSTALS-Kyber post-quantum KEM: Module-LWE key generation, encapsulation, decapsulation (NIST FIPS 203)
concept_behind: The algorithm replacing RSA/ECC in TLS, SSH, Signal

name: Q-SHOR
desc: Shor's factoring algorithm: quantum period-finding via QFT simulation, classical GCD post-processing
concept_behind: Why RSA breaks with quantum computers — the attack Kyber defends against

name: Q-QEC
desc: Quantum error correction: 3-qubit bit/phase-flip codes, Shor 9-qubit code, Steane [[7,1,3]] stabilizer code
concept_behind: Fault-tolerant quantum computing — the engineering layer enabling quantum advantage

name: Q-VQE
desc: Variational Quantum Eigensolver + QAOA: parametric ansatz circuits, parameter-shift gradients, H₂ molecule
concept_behind: Near-term (NISQ) quantum algorithms for chemistry and combinatorial optimization

name: Q-PACK
desc: LZSS + canonical Huffman compression — the DEFLATE recipe (RFC 1951) with stored-block fallback
concept_behind: gzip / zlib / PNG — and the compression stage of QSF

name: Q-SIGN
desc: Hash-based post-quantum signatures: WOTS chains + Merkle tree, one-time-leaf state tracking
concept_behind: XMSS (RFC 8391) / SPHINCS+ (NIST FIPS 205) — signatures Shor's algorithm cannot break

name: Q-QSF
desc: QSF — Quantum-Safe File format: LZSS compression + Kyber encryption + hash-based signing in one container
concept_behind: What PGP/age become when every primitive must survive a quantum computer

name: Q-DILITHIUM
desc: CRYSTALS-Dilithium post-quantum digital signatures: Module-LWE keygen, sign, verify (NIST FIPS 204)
concept_behind: The algorithm replacing ECDSA/RSA-PSS in TLS certificates, SSH host keys, code signing

name: Q-RAFT
desc: Raft distributed consensus: leader election, log replication, snapshots, partition tolerance
concept_behind: etcd / CockroachDB / TiKV / Consul — linearizable consensus for distributed systems

name: Q-BLOOM
desc: Bloom + Counting + Xor + Cuckoo filters, HyperLogLog cardinality, MinHash / LSH similarity
concept_behind: RocksDB / Redis / Elasticsearch / Cassandra — space-efficient probabilistic data structures

name: Q-ATTENTION
desc: The Transformer from scratch: scaled dot-product + multi-head attention, causal masking, positional encoding, LayerNorm, GELU feed-forward, full encoder block
concept_behind: GPT / Claude / Gemini / Llama / BERT / Stable Diffusion — the attention mechanism (Vaswani et al. 2017)

name: Q-CRDT
desc: Conflict-free replicated data types: vector clocks, G/PN counters, LWW register, OR-set, RGA collaborative sequence, convergence proofs
concept_behind: Figma / Linear / Notion / Automerge / Yjs / Riak — local-first & real-time collaboration
